WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT orderslink,
         AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
         AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rate_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
  FROM step1
)
SELECT step1.orderslink,
       step1.avg_rebtotal,
       step1.avg_rate_ratio,
       step1.avg_rate_ratio / step2.overall_avg_ratio
FROM step1
JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY step1.avg_rate_ratio / step2.overall_avg_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
